newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary bourse terminates Vektor's membership.
newsitem.headline: Hungary bourse terminates Vektor's membership.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said the bourse membership of Vektor Broker Rt has been terminated due to its links to a privatisation scandal, the BSE Council said in a statement on Tuesday.

The BSE ended Vektor Broker's membership at the company's request with effect on February 11. Vektor Broker had completed all its deals on the BSE and fulfilled all payment obligations to the bourse and central clearing house Keler, the BSE said.

Hungary's bourse watchdog imposed restrictions on Vektor Broker at the end of last year, citing possible risks to investors due to the unclear links between Vektor Broker and Vektor Penzugyi Befektetesi Tanacsado Rt (Vektor PBT) PBT, a financial consulting company that represented local authorities in talks with privatisation agency APV Rt.

APV negotiator Marta Tocsik triggered a scandal resulting in the sacking of privatisation minister Tamas Suchman and the entire APV board when it was made public that she had received commissions worth millions of dollars for her role.
